conceptZh: 廚師動物邊揉麵邊唱歌，小鴨子慢一拍學唱。
object: a rotund chef cat in a tall hat and a tiny duckling copying it
morph: chef and duckling's musical notes line up into strokes forming 唱
creativeAngle: 小鴨慢一拍模仿廚師揮麵團和張嘴唱歌，造成可愛的錯拍，音符變成筆畫。
promptEn:
An 8-second animated clip on a warm peach-cream kitchen-stage backdrop. Lead: a rotund cartoon chef cat in a very tall white hat, tossing pizza dough with extra confidence. A small yellow duckling in a paper chef hat copies every move one beat late. The finished glyph 唱 is a saturated tomato-red, centered, about 70% of frame height.
0.0-1.7s: the chef flings a dough disc up, catches it on his head; one beat later the duckling flings a tiny dough disc, and it lands over the chef's eyes. First "唱" as the chef opens his mouth wide and a big musical note puffs out.
1.7-3.3s: copycat mix-up: the chef spins, the duckling spins the other way and they bump bellies; the second "唱" lands as the duckling's note collides with the chef's note and both notes stick on the stage as the mouth-strokes of the glyph.
3.3-5.0s: the chef points a wooden spoon like a baton, the duckling pecks a second note; stacked notes slide into the remaining strokes and 唱 appears with a bright ding.
5.0-8.0s: HOLD, glyph perfectly still. On "唱歌" the chef and duckling sing silently with big mouths into spoon microphones, sway together, the duckling one beat late, hats bobbing beside the glyph.
Audio: Off-screen voice, warm and friendly, clear Taiwanese Mandarin, slow and distinct, reading exactly "唱、唱、唱歌" (ㄔㄤˋ、ㄔㄤˋ、ㄔㄤˋ ㄍㄜ) with clear tones: the character, a short pause, the character again, then the word once, and nothing after it. No subtitles or vocabulary text; the only text on screen is the single glyph 唱.
No other text, no watermark, no flashing, no real people.
